title: Output multiset size bound
statement: Let $k,n,a,b$ be positive integers with $k\le n$ and $2a\le b$. Form the almost $k$-wise construction with output dimension $n$ and requested bias $a/b$, and let $R$ be its row count and $S=\lceil Rb/a\rceil$. The cardinality of its output multiset is at most $4S^2$.
